description:
Replace every libgit2 read with the git module, drop the binding and its OpenSSL linkage from the workspace, and correct the documentation that describes the old behaviour.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No workspace crate depends on git2, `Cargo.lock` holds neither git2 nor libgit2-sys, and the build-policy check rejects libgit2 and OpenSSL linkage.
- [hard] REQ-02: Issue reads load no git object; document show, history, diff and asset checks, snapshot export, archive planning and reads at a commit go through the git module.
- [hard] REQ-03: The server image ships the git executable, and user and contributor documents describe the new read sources and git requirements.
title: The workspace reaches git without libgit2
